suggestions.reason: The expectation could be more precise: the output correctly identifies the contradiction and mentions 15-step tutorial and confirmation dialogs, but does not explicitly mention '10 progress nodes' or '12 stages' from the design document. Consider either relaxing the expectation to focus on the core contradiction, or explicitly requiring all UI elements to be listed.

The most important finding - that AskUserQuestion tool was not invoked despite explicit skill instructions - is correctly captured in expectation 3. This is a critical gap because the skill explicitly instructs tool use for clarification, yet the agent wrote questions into the output file instead of actually asking them. This could lead to the user never receiving the clarification questions in an interactive session.

Consider adding an assertion that checks whether the clarification questions written in the output file match the types of questions the skill instructs to ask. The output has valid questions (lines 166-172), but they weren't delivered via the intended mechanism.
